name: reladraw
use_label: Diagram language with your own layout
one_liner: A text language for diagrams where you decide where things go.

text.why: Mermaid and friends choose the layout for you, and draw.io means dragging every box by hand. reladraw sits between: the convenience of text with the freedom to place things.
text.take: Agents can draw with it too, by stating relationships instead of computing coordinates.
build: You write boxes and connections as text and place them relative to each other. It runs in the browser, and the repository includes examples such as a server architecture diagram.

who.role: Developers and planners who draw architecture diagrams often.

start.text: Try it in the browser at reladraw.github.io/reladraw.

caveat: There is a new syntax to learn, and the project is young.

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: A diagram drawn with reladraw: external drive, home server, desktops and laptops linked to cloud sync with arrows.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
